summary: `agent resume` needs_review is an object keyed by work id while the other work lists are arrays
expected: Consistent shapes: lists of work items with id/title/reason.
actual: Ride Options resume returned needs_review {'281b3f40…': 'Deferred by the 2026-10-09 portfolio review…'}; Foundry returned {} and work/superseded are arrays of objects. A generic summariser crashed on the dict.
reproduction: Run `resume` in ride-options and in foundry; compare the needs_review type with superseded/work.
impact: Minor: scripts must special-case one key.
suggestion: Return needs_review as a list of {work_id, title, reason} (keep the dict under another key for one release if compatibility matters).
